Each job loads its window once, then reads only what changed since its last run. Jobs Failing and Runs Failed should both read zero.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "a3", "type": "header", "data": {"text": "Set up, in this order", "col": 12}}, {"id": "a4", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "1. Turn on the Analytics::Pipeline::runs switch in Feature Flags.
2. Open a job under Jobs. Set Window (days), then its Frequency, or After job.
3. Turn the job on. Its first run loads the window; later runs read only what changed.
4. Turn on the jobs that run after it. Rebuild on a job reloads its window, never more than 30 days.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "a5", "type": "header", "data": {"text": "Pipeline", "col": 12}}, {"id": "a6", "type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Analytics Jobs On", "col": 3}}, {"id": "a7", "type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Analytics Jobs Failing", "col": 3}}, {"id": "a8", "type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Analytics Runs 7d", "col": 3}}, {"id": "a9", "type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Analytics Runs Failed 7d", "col": 3}}, {"id": "a10", "type": "chart", "data": {"chart_name": "Analytics Runs by Job", "col": 6}}, {"id": "a11", "type": "chart", "data": {"chart_name": "Analytics Runs by Status", "col": 6}}, {"id": "a12", "type": "header", "data": {"text": "Call audit", "col": 12}}, {"id": "a13", "type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Calls Audited", "col": 3}}, {"id": "a14", "type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Calls Flagged", "col": 3}}, {"id": "a15", "type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Agents Scored", "col": 3}}, {"id": "a16", "type": "number_card", "data": {"number_card_name": "Agents High Risk", "col": 3}}, {"id": "a17", "type": "chart", "data": {"chart_name": "Calls by Why Not Valid", "col": 6}}, {"id": "a18", "type": "chart", "data": {"chart_name": "Agents by Risk Tier", "col": 6}}, {"id": "a19", "type": "header", "data": {"text": "References", "col": 12}}, {"id": "a20", "type": "card", "data": {"card_name": "Pipeline", "col": 4}}, {"id": "a21", "type": "card", "data": {"card_name": "Call tables", "col": 4}}, {"id": "a22", "type": "card", "data": {"card_name": "Team tables", "col": 4}}]
